title: Institution-Specific LLM Prompting Recovers PHI That De-identification Systems and Their Gold Standards Both Miss
abstract: arXiv:2608.17051v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Secondary use of electronic health records requires de-identification, yet existing systems miss \emph{institutionally situated} protected health information (PHI) such as hospital abbreviations, building names, and internal codes whose status is locally determined. We ask whether large language models (LLMs) with in-context learning (ICL) can close this gap and control the precision--recall trade-off.   On 100 annotated pediatric oncology notes (5,322 PHI spans) from Texas Children's Hospital, we benchmarked eight LLMs against two purpose-built systems (Stanford TiDE, OpenMed PII) and two pattern-based baselines. Each LLM ran under three prompts of increasing specificity: (1) a HIPAA-aligned baseline, (2) baseline plus the institutional PHI categories it missed, and (3) prompt 2 plus instructions against over-redacting clinical content. translated_title: 机构特定的大语言模型提示恢复去标识化系统及其金标准均遗漏的受保护健康信息
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17051v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：电子健康记录的二次使用需要去标识化，但现有系统会遗漏机构特定情境下的受保护健康信息（PHI），例如医院缩写、建筑名称和内部代码，这些信息的状态由当地决定。我们探究是否可以通过上下文学习（ICL）的大语言模型（LLMs）来弥补这一差距，并控制精确率-召回率的权衡。在来自德克萨斯儿童医院的100份带注释的儿科肿瘤学笔记（5,322个PHI片段）上，我们将八种LLM与两种专用系统（Stanford TiDE、OpenMed PII）和两种基于模式的基线进行了基准测试。每个LLM在三种特异性递增的提示下运行：（1）符合HIPAA的基线，（2）基线加上其遗漏的机构PHI类别，以及（3）提示2加上避免过度编辑临床内容的指令。然后，我们比较了14种多代理和集成配置与最佳单一提示的效果，并进行了重新评估。
tldr: 本研究提出使用机构特定的LLM提示方法，能够有效恢复去标识化系统遗漏的机构相关PHI，并优化精确率与召回率的平衡。
en_tdlr: This study proposes institution-specific LLM prompting to recover institutionally situated PHI missed by de-identification systems and optimize the precision-recall trade-off.
